title: Unwrap Narwhals DataFrames to native pandas before checking sparse attributes in check_array
answers: Why does check_array crash on narwhals.DataFrame input?
How to inspect pandas sparse attributes on a Narwhals DataFrame in validation?
check_array fails with AttributeError on narwhals DataFrame
body:
Symptom: check_array raises an error when passed a narwhals.DataFrame input backed by pandas.
Root cause: sklearn/utils/validation.py:check_array checked sparse attributes directly on array instead of unwrapping the Narwhals wrapper.
Fix pattern: Convert the Narwhals DataFrame to its native representation using .to_native() before checking pandas-specific attributes like .sparse or .dtypes.
Constraints: Applies when check_array receives or wraps data in Narwhals DataFrames; does not apply to NumPy ndarrays or SciPy sparse arrays.
